sources.title: AI-based Framework for Robust Model-Based Connector Mating in Robotic ...
sources.snippet: Despite the widespread adoption of industrial robots in automotive assembly, wire harness installation remains a largely manual process, as it requires precise and flexible manipulation. To address this challenge, we design a novel AI-based framework that automates cable connector mating by integrating force control with deep visuotactile learning.
